fix(daemon): a held slot owns what recurs while it holds

A held slot counts what recurs while it holds an event, and hands that to
its owner when it lets the event go: at its hold's end, at an answer past the
hold, and at disposal. The daemon's task errors are just slots, its close
flushes nothing by hand, and one formatter writes a throw's words for the bar
and its detail for the log.

`detach` settles a sync throw as it settles a rejection, so a task's throw
never reaches the code that detached it, whatever the clock reports to.
`failed` is the one way to report a failure an owner holds as a value.

A trailing edge reports each pass's throw as it happens, so a loop that
changes keep alive still shows its failures. Config discovery reports an
origin it could not observe before it publishes. A renderer's failed due turn
reaches every bar. A wait begun closed reports a sync throw from its work.

fix(daemon): a task's held error counts its throws and shows them once a hold

A task's error is identified by its task, so the daemon no longer compares a
throw's message against a copy of the last one. The task's held event is the
one record of what its error says. A throw while the error is held is
counted, whatever it says. When the hold ends with throws counted, the latest
cause is held and logged once with their count, so a task failing on every
tick moves bars and the log once a hold.

A throw keeps its own words: a watch's holders each run as a clock task named
for the watch, and a wait's work that fails after the wait ended is reported
as the wait's task after its wait, with no wrapper hiding the cause.

The inbox's taker is a state: a second attach is refused, and the daemon's
close and a refused boot hand it to the log. Taking a throw never throws
back into the task. A disposed held slot holds nothing.

A wait's work that throws before returning fails the wait at once again.
Config discovery reports an origin it could not observe only after the batch
has published what its siblings observed. A bar pane's apply is named for
the pane. The daemon's clock has one builder.

fix(daemon): every unawaited settle is a named clock task

The daemon takes only a reporting clock, which carries the inbox its task
throws land in, so the clock and the bar's error list cannot be wired apart.
A throw repeated with the same message stays quiet, and a new message is
logged once and joins the held error.

Work that settled through a bare promise chain now runs as a named clock
task: a bar pane's effect, each keyed queue's drain, a wait whose work fails
after its deadline, and a launch's after-exit steps. A throw past their own
handlers reaches every bar instead of vanishing.

Each keyed source's refresh event names how many holders share it.

fix(daemon): every clock task's throw reaches the bar

A clock is now built only over a reporter of what its tasks throw
(`clockOver`), and only the process world builds one over the machine's
bare timers, which lint fences to src/host.ts. Every task is named.

The daemon's reporter holds one error per task on every bar, logs its
full detail once, and counts every throw in stats. A held throw refuses
recordings, since its message may carry a command's output.

Fire-and-forget work across the daemon (git refresh, PR lookup, watch
delivery, retires, log flush, launches, config discovery, the binary
watch) runs as clock tasks instead of `void`/log-only catches, and typed
lint refuses a floating promise in src. Continuations that must run
whatever a task throws sit in `finally`.

## [1.236.2](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.236.1...v1.236.2) (2026-11-20)

### Bug Fixes

* **sources:** distinguish invalid inputs from typed empty values ([#897](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/897)) ([c957046](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/c957046c1280833322d322ac37f7edd30d094ff7))

fix(config): one key classifier, one write router, and Back steps that end with their edit

What a session key is (edit mode's own, a setting, a confirm, the
viewer, a menu, an author's) is decided by one function, and every
reader and writer switches on it. Every session write passes one
router: an open edit holds it, and with none open edit mode's keys are
set aside for the edit a click opens, or dropped and logged. An edit
holds the Back steps taken in it, and the click that ends it lands its
own step outside, without edit mode's keys. Whether an edit has work is
the files it changed and the drafts a save writes, one count for the
save cell, cancel and the idle close. The duplicate-id hint is fixed
text, the click error reads only records this build writes, and a
session left empty by the load takes no slot.

fix(config): decide edit-or-store once per click and check authored keys wherever they load

A click outside an edit holds edit mode's keys aside: they open the edit
it starts, or are dropped and logged at warn. Every reader takes the
edit's view, the main undo never records an edit key, and drafts are
neither main-undo nor navigation state. A closed edit's steps are never
Back destinations because its state never reaches the store.

The authored-key check runs for plugins too, refuses raw keys by
namespace and accordion keys only where they meet the bar's own. The
click error lives under the settings namespace. Hover text decodes menu
keys. Minted placement ids retry a bounded number of times and throw.
fix(config): give re-added placements a fresh id and keep edit-mode state in the edit

fix(settings): fold every pick through one setting table and warn on stale picks

A session pick its setting can no longer hold (an uninstalled or retired theme, an undeclared style or preset, a dropped effect, an out-of-range value, a placement value outside its declaration) now reads through its setting's one parse as stale. The fold draws what lies beneath it and reports which rung decided, and the frame shows one stale warning per stale pick that decided, naming the setting, the spelling held, what the bar wears and what the setting can hold. Every save releases every pick that is not a draft against the config it wrote, and a state variable may no longer read a setting's session key.
